```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(rvest)
library(tibble)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
resp <- GET("https://api.sampleapis.com/futurama/characters")
api_data <- content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
characters_tbl <- fromJSON(api_data) %>% as_tibble()
head(characters_tbl)
```

```{r}
books_html <- read_html("https://example-data.draft.dev/books")
books_tbl <- books_html %>%
  html_element("table") %>%
  html_table()
head(books_tbl)
```

## Notes
Describe how the structure and cleaning needs differ between the API JSON payload and the scraped HTML table.
